How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for BHEL Part Time Medical Consultant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 26-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BHEL PTMC recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Part-Time Medical Consultant (PTMC) position at BHEL is 26th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the PTMC post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree and have a minimum of one year of relevant experience to be eligible for the Part-Time Medical Consultant position.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the PTMC post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Part-Time Medical Consultant (PTMC) position in this recruitment drive by BHEL.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the PTMC position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Part-Time Medical Consultant (PTMC) post is 70 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the PTMC role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Part-Time Medical Consultant (PTMC) role will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 68,400 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the BHEL PTMC recruitment must be submitted via email. Ensure all required documents are attached and the subject line is correctly mentioned.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the PTMC post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Part-Time Medical Consultant (PTMC) position will involve Document Verification followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this BHEL recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL).

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this PTMC position?
faq.answer: The job location for the Part-Time Medical Consultant (PTMC) position is Goindwal, Punjab.
